mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diary( trip_id, member_id, content, visibility, status, is_ai_generated, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tripId}, #{memberId}, #{content}, #{visibility}, 'ACTIVE', 'N', NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT d.diary_id, d.trip_id, d.member_id, d.content, d.visibility, d.status, d.is_ai_generated, d.created_at, d.updated_at FROM diary d WHERE d.diary_id = #{diaryId} AND (d.status IS NULL OR d.status != 'DELETED')
mapper.update: UPDATE diary SET content = #{content}, visibility = #{visibility}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE diary_id = #{diaryId} AND (status IS NULL OR status != 'DELETED')
UPDATE diary SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE diary_id = #{diaryId} AND (status IS NULL OR status != 'DELETED')
